ABOUT

Design with intention. Build with intelligence.

Abhishek Dave is a brand and graphic designer with a growing technical foundation in artificial intelligence — currently pursuing a B.Tech in AI-CS after coming from a diploma background.

Alongside his design practice, he teaches Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and AI to diploma and B.Tech students, and works as a freelance brand designer, most notably building out the full identity system for GETGOOEY — covering logo design, packaging, menu design, kiosk design, color palette systems, and thank-you card design.

SELECTED WORK

Brand systems I've built.

Freelance branding work, led end-to-end — logo, packaging, menus, signage, and social creatives, delivered for real clients.

01
Café Branding / Freelance

Cafe Amistoso — Full Brand Identity & Menu System

Cafe Amistoso — "Coffee & Connections" — is a complete café branding project built by Abhishek from the ground up: the circular brand emblem, in-store wall signage, a QR-code menu system for contactless ordering, and social-media-ready promotional creatives for signature drinks like the Mocha Chocochip and Sea Salt Mocha.

02
Food Brand / Freelance

Patil Bandhu — Brand Logo & Packaging Design

पाटीलबन्धु (Patil Bandhu) — "True Taste of Tradition" — is a vada pav brand for which Abhishek designed the circular brand mark, built around a modak motif, along with the complete takeaway packaging box used for serving their signature vada pav.

03
Bakery Brand / Freelance

Crumbly Cookies & More — Packaging & Brand Collateral

Crumbly Cookies & More — "Little Bites, Big Happiness" — needed a packaging suite that felt as warm as the product itself. Abhishek designed the mailer box, the branded logo sticker, a handwritten-style thank-you card insert, and a cloth pouch, tied together with a hand-drawn cookie-crumb motif.

Coffee Brand / Freelance

Brew & Bean — Packaging & Visual Identity

Brew & Bean — "Good Coffee, Better Days" — is a coffee brand packaging system covering the takeaway cup, a kraft paper carry bag, and a delivery box, unified through a botanical green-and-kraft palette and a custom logomark blending a coffee bean with a sparkle.
